issues.problem: The verdict contradicts the pick. The reader chooses the correct option 'No: the card is made when someone asks for it' and the verdict opens 'Yes. The card URL is a route handler…'. On 3-serving ('Why does the CDN fetch from the API…?') and 2-gravatar think3 (flag on photo or column on user?), the verdict also opens 'Yes.', which answers neither a why-question nor an A-or-B choice.
issues.fix: Start every verdict with words that agree with the option picked: 'Right: nothing is stored…' on 1-images, 'Right: S3 can't know which photo is active…' on 3-serving, 'Right: a column on the user…' on 2-gravatar think3. Check the wrong-pick verdict on all 11 cards the same way, and make each one name the correct option.

issues.problem: Figure desert. Between Fig 4·a (three hats) and Fig 4·b (§4.5) there are about 7 desktop screens and about 10 phone screens with no figure. They hold prose, one pause card and two 'More precisely' boxes, and cover four design decisions: the who-can-tag-me ACL, 5 vs 10,000 tags, notification load and clubbing, and the synchronous ML suggestion dependency. This breaks the sample's paragraph–figure–paragraph rhythm.
issues.fix: Add 2–3 small sheets. (a) §4.2: move the authz half of Fig 4·c here, as tagger → tagging service → authz with a per-user ACL row 'can X tag me?' and a self-removal arrow. (b) §4.3: '5 vs 10,000', side by side: an array inside the photo record vs a posts_tags row-per-tag table plus a paginated endpoint, and under it one photo fanning out to N notifications vs one clubbed notification. (c) §4.4: tagging → ML suggestions as a synchronous call, with an SLA/timeout tick and a 'fallback: tag manually' branch.

issues.problem: In step 5 the clear starts in the worker lane. The 'a tap: clear' arrow and both DEL arrows leave the status-update worker. A tap goes through the status API (Fig 5·e, 6·c), not the worker, so the initiator is wrong. The labels are also misplaced: 'DEL B_C B_D' sits over the arrow to main, while the arrow to aux carries only 'a tap: clear'.
issues.fix: Add a 'status api' lane, or draw step 5's arrows from a small api box at the top. Put 'DEL B_C B_D' on the arrow into aux and 'DEL B' on the arrow into main, and keep the label 'a tap' at the source.

issues.fix: Either rewrite the caption and the clip-as-text to cover the full story ('50 messages from two senders: 48 change nothing; with aux, 2 writes and 48 cheap checks'), or end the poster on the C-only beat (30 / 29 / 1).
